item.title: Intermittent fasting is unlikely to cause greater weight loss than traditional dieting, study finds
item.description: Intermittent fasting has been touted as a weight-loss approach by social media influencers, but new research suggests it is unlikely to lead to greater weight-loss than traditional dieting methods.

item.title: Joel Embiid out for Sixers-Pelicans on Saturday in front end of back-to-back
item.description: Joel Embiid went over a month without having an unplanned absence. He has missed three games in a row since.

item.title: Willow Grove man will serve 2 years in prison for insider trading
item.description: Carlos Sacanell, 59, of Willow Grove will serve two years in prison for buying stock in Oak Street Health based on insider information from his girlfriend, an executive at the company. CVS acquired the primary care network in 2023.

item.title: Maritime museum at Jersey Shore heavily damaged by burst pipe
item.description: The New Jersey Maritime Museum, which houses artifacts from shipwrecks and other historical relics, suffered extensive damage last week after a pipe burst at the Beach Haven property.

item.title: Here's how to spot Easter eggs that Isaiah Zagar hid in many of his mosaics
item.description: Isaiah Zagar, who died Thursday at the age of 86, frequently hid himself, his wife, pets, motto and artists he admired in his mixed-media mosaics across South Philly. Here's how to spot the Easter eggs.

item.title: Do positive affirmations work? A psychologist unpacks the evidence
item.description: Self-affirmation theory suggests repeating positive ideas about yourself can protect you from negative mental health symptoms, boosting your mood and sense of self-worth. Scientific research suggests this works in some cases, but there are downsides.

item.title: Checking in on recent former Phillies: Nick Castellanos, Harrison Bader, Walker Buehler settle out west
item.description: As much as it seems like the Phillies are running it back for 2026 — and in many ways they are — they did say goodbye to a lot of players over the past year.

item.title: Daniel Jeremiah talks Eagles ahead of the 2026 NFL Draft
item.description: On Thursday, former Philadelphia Eagles scout and current NFL Network draft analyst Daniel Jeremiah spent a couple hours answering questions from reporters about the 2026 NFL Draft. Some of those questions were about the Eagles. Here's what Jeremiah said, and I'll throw in my two cents as well.

item.title: Unlikely romance turns messy in ‘Can’t Forget About You’ U.S. premiere
item.description: Inis Nua Theatre Company will present the American premiere of David Ireland’s romantic comedy “Can’t Forget About You” from March 18 through April 5 at the Drake Theatre in Center City.

item.title: Instant observations: Another horrid loss for Sixers, suddenly searching for sources of offense
item.description: Facing a team tied for the second-worst record in the NBA playing on the second leg of a back-to-back, the Sixers were bulldozed in the second half on Saturday.
